text: {"cases":[{"id":"C01","status":"conflict","pairs":[["C01-A","C01-B"]],"reason":"C01-A states NASA's 2023 anomaly was about 1.2 C above the 1951–1980 average, with about 2.1 F as the Fahrenheit equivalent.
